title: Turn a square of paper into a swan, with folds alone
alt: A white paper crane with pointed wings against a blue background.

posts.facebook:
All you need is a square of paper.

With folds alone, origami turns it into a swan, a penguin or a cat's head.

The British Origami Society and OrigamiUSA both share free diagrams, so you could fold your first model tonight. If you'd like company, libraries run beginners' classes and local folding groups meet in the UK and the US.

What would you fold first?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-origami/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
